title: Vectors: Sequence exhaustion scenarios
close_reason: SATISFIED: sequence/counter exhaustion is vectorized in two files. test/vectors/replay_window.json: same_epoch_sequence_wrap_rejected (seqnum 0 after 65535 in same epoch rejected as old) and terminal_counter_wrap_rejected ((255,65535)->(0,0) rejected; key rotation required). test/vectors/epoch_rollover.json: epoch_rollover_forbidden (epoch 255 rollover attempt rejected) and sender_sequence vectors incl. key_rotation_required_after exhaustion transcript and tuple_ordering_near_rollover_* boundary orderings. Consumed by the same suites: python/tests/test_vectors.py -k 'replay_window or epoch_rollover' and rust/lichen-link/tests/shared_vectors.rs::test_replay_window_vectors + ::test_epoch_rollover_vectors. Ran: cd python && uv run --extra dev pytest tests/test_vectors.py -k replay_window -q => 25 passed; -k epoch_rollover -q => 22 passed; cd rust && cargo test -p lichen-link --features 'schnorr,std' --test shared_vectors => 6 passed.
